mapper.select: select item_id, item_cd, item_nm, unit_cd, use_yn, attrs ->> 'ALLOC_STRATEGY' as alloc_attr, attrs ->> 'SHELF_LIFE_DAYS' as shelf_life_attr from mst_item where (#{itemId}::bigint is not null and item_id = #{itemId}) or (#{itemId}::bigint is null and item_cd = #{itemCd})
select exists (select 1 from sys_plant where plant_cd = #{plantCd})
select exists (select 1 from mst_equip_hier where node_id = #{nodeId} and plant_cd = #{plantCd} and node_type in ('WH', 'LOC'))

with recursive scope as ( select node_id, 1 as lv from mst_equip_hier where node_id = #{nodeId} union all select c.node_id, s.lv + 1 from scope s join mst_equip_hier c on c.parent_id = s.node_id where s.lv < 20 ), stock as ( select s.node_id, s.stock_status, s.lot_id, s.qty, () as avail_loc, () as lot_free from inv_stock s where s.item_id = #{itemId} and s.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and s.qty > 0 and s.node_id in (select node_id from scope) ), led as ( select t.node_id, t.stock_status, t.lot_id, t.qty, t.occurred_at, row_number() over w as rn, sum(t.qty) over w as bal from inv_trx t join stock k on k.node_id = t.node_id and k.stock_status = t.stock_status and k.lot_id is not distinct from t.lot_id where t.item_id = #{itemId} window w as (partition by t.node_id, t.stock_status, t.lot_id order by t.occurred_at, t.trx_id) ), marks as ( select l.*, max(case when l.bal <= 0 then l.rn end) over (partition by l.node_id, l.stock_status, l.lot_id) as last_zero from led l ), fifo as ( select node_id, stock_status, lot_id, min(occurred_at) filter (where rn > coalesce(last_zero, 0) and qty > 0) as fifo_at from marks group by node_id, stock_status, lot_id ) select k.node_id, n.node_cd, wms_node_path(k.node_id) as path, coalesce(a.pick_seq, 0) as pick_seq, k.lot_id, lm.lot_no, k.stock_status, k.qty, coalesce(lm.occurred_at, f.fifo_at) as fifo_at, k.avail_loc, k.lot_free from stock k join mst_equip_hier n on n.node_id = k.node_id left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = k.node_id left join fifo f on f.node_id = k.node_id and f.stock_status = k.stock_status and f.lot_id is not distinct from k.lot_id left join lot_master lm on lm.lot_id = k.lot_id order by k.node_id, k.lot_id nulls first, k.stock_status
